card.name: University course description sentences
card.fires_on: Words inside academic course catalog descriptions, mostly in the middle of a sentence about what the course covers or how it is taught (e.g. 'are used', 'We will examine', 'and so forth').

modes.label: Teaching-method phrases
modes.description: Verbs and links describing how the course is run, right after lists of math or science topics.
modes.example: Various manipulative and problem solving strategies are<< used>>. Prerequisite: MTH 9

modes.label: Course scope statements
modes.description: Verbs or end-of-list words in sentences saying what the course will examine or discuss.
modes.example: We will<< examine>> the health and environmental effects of air pollutants

card.writes: Suppresses Chinese counting and quantity words, so it adds little clear output effect for English course text.
card.plain: It fires on the wording of university course catalog blurbs, as they describe topics and teaching methods.
